changeSet.sql: create table CARD ( ID NUMBER(38) DEFAULT card_seq.nextval NOT NULL, ACCOUNT_ID NUMBER(38) NOT NULL, NAME VARCHAR2(100) NOT NULL, NOTES VARCHAR2(1000), TIMESTAMP_CREATION TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL, TIMESTAMP_UPDATED TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL, CARD_HOLDER VARCHAR2(100), "NUMBER" VARCHAR2(100), EXPIRATION DATE, CVV VARCHAR2(3) )
ALTER TABLE CARD ADD (CONSTRAINT card_pk PRIMARY KEY (ID));
ALTER TABLE CARD ADD CONSTRAINT card_account_fk FOREIGN KEY (ACCOUNT_ID) REFERENCES ACCOUNT (ID);
